items.record: PK=<function>#<idempotency key> | status IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETED, inProgressUntil (ms), result (JSON), expiresAtEpoch

accessPatterns: claim: PutItem IF attribute_not_exists(PK) OR (status = IN_PROGRESS AND inProgressUntil < now) - a crashed attempt's claim expires
complete: UpdateItem SET status = COMPLETED, result
failure: DeleteItem (the retry may run again)
_design.why: SQS is at-least-once and Lambda retries batches: the same message can run twice concurrently on two containers; a conditional write is the cheapest cross-container lock with automatic expiry
